The token is already printed, so the identity is known but not resolved for display.

examples.why: Token-numbered call sites (__cil_callvirt_/__cil_direct_/__cil_methodspec_call_/__cil_newobj_/__cil_ldstr_) appear 1390 times, so receivers and callees are unnamed even where a member name is available.
examples.fix: Emit the resolved callee/member name at token-numbered call sites (the member ref is what produced the token).
examples.risk: low - name resolution already happens for a subset of call sites

examples.ilspy: public Player LocalPlayer { get; private set; }
examples.why: Auto-property backing fields surface as __il_field_<token> field declarations (378 occurrences, 115 distinct) plus get_/set_ accessor methods, instead of a property.
examples.fix: Fold backing-field + accessor pairs into an auto-property (see structure category); suppress this. on member access.
examples.risk: low - the accessor bodies are empty assignment/read pairs in 0 of the cases that matter; verify each pair before folding

examples.why: CFG is printed as goto + bare IL_xxxx labels (1,566 gotos, 1,400 labels, 524 else-blocks whose only content is a goto) instead of nested if/else.
examples.fix: Structure the CFG into plain nesting and drop labels/goto; re-test the receiver temp (v1 vs v3 both load RenderPlayer).
examples.risk: medium - needs a proven single-entry/single-exit structuring; the labels come from that pass, so it is a printing/structuring decision, not new IL analysis

examples.why: unchecked(...) is applied to every integer operation (690 occurrences) although C# is unchecked by default and the image is not compiled with /checked. Missing ++ and compound assignment (0 in ours, 53 ++ and 21 += in ILSpy) forces extra temps.
examples.fix: Drop unchecked around operations that provably originate from an unchecked context; recover x = x op y as compound assignment and x = x +- 1 as ++/--.
examples.risk: low for dropping unchecked and compound assignment (same operation, same order); the image-wide checked context must be confirmed once

examples.why: The compiler's non-capturing lambda cache (if (cache != null) ... else cache = new <>c().<M>b__x) is reproduced literally: 377 cache stores and 263 s<N>_<M> slots. The lambda bodies themselves are emitted readably (GetNamespacesLambda4_0 etc.).
examples.fix: Collapse the cache pattern to the lambda expression and drop the s/e slot temporaries; optionally rewrite the LINQ method chain as a query expression.
examples.risk: low - cache fields are static and side-effect free; the delegate identity must be preserved (same static instance) which collapsing does

examples.ilspy: public Session LobbyInfo => OrderManager.LobbyInfo;
examples.why: Every value is threaded through a fresh temp and returned by name (222 'return v<N>;' after an immediately preceding assignment; index assign_then_return 182 in ours vs 0 in ILSpy).
examples.fix: Inline single-use temporaries into the consuming expression when the first use is the only use and no side-effect reordering occurs.
examples.risk: low - single-use, same statement

examples.why: Zero using directives in all five files (ILSpy emits 10-15 per file), so every type reference is fully qualified: 6,618 FQN tokens and 1,594 global:: prefixes.
examples.fix: Collect required namespaces, emit using directives, and print short type names; suppress global:: where no ambiguity exists.
examples.risk: low - purely presentational; conflicts must collapse to an alias or FQN

examples.ours:
OpenRA.Game.lastConnectionState = unchecked((__cil_enum_020001CE)(0));
OpenRA.Game.state = unchecked((__cil_enum_020000BC)(2147483647));
examples.ilspy:
private static ConnectionState lastConnectionState = ConnectionState.PreConnecting;
private static RunStatus state = RunStatus.Running;
examples.why: Enums are printed through __cil_enum_<token> aliases and raw integers (83 uses), losing the enum member name. RunStatus.Running has value int.MaxValue and is printed only as 2147483647 - a real information loss, not just noise.
examples.fix: Print the enum type name and the named member when the constant matches a declared field (fall back to the cast for undefined values).
examples.risk: low - the enum's fields are in metadata; only the lookup is missing

examples.ours:

__cil_callvirt_06000574(v159, __cil_call_arg_r4(v160));

examples.ours: private const string SavedScreenshot = "\u006E\u006F\u0074\u0069\u0066...";

[FluentReference(new string[] { "filename" })]
private const string SavedScreenshot = "notification-saved-screenshot";
examples.why: The \uXXXX escaping path applies only to metadata constants (const string fields, default parameter values) - 1 instance in this slice. ldstr literals print literally inside __cil_ldstr_<token>("...") (146 instances). The attribute is also dropped.
examples.fix: Emit printable characters directly in constant values; print custom attributes on declarations.
examples.risk: low - escaping must still apply to non-printable and quote/backslash characters

examples.why: 68 properties and 12 events are emitted as get_/set_/add_/remove_ methods with a header comment block at the end of the type body, so the class reads as 100+ methods with no visible properties. The synthesis data already exists (the footer comment is generated from it).
examples.fix: Fold accessor method pairs back into property/event declarations at their metadata position and delete the footer comment block.
examples.risk: low - the property/event classification is already decided; only rendering changes

examples.why: All field initializers are hoisted into static constructors (Map 20 initializers, Game 15), so the declaration reads without its value and the type gains a 46-line .cctor. Omitted optional arguments are also filled in as raw null/1 instead of being elided.
examples.fix: When a static constructor consists only of field stores, move each initializer to its field declaration and recover array/object initializers.
examples.risk: medium - the store order in the .cctor must be preserved for fields with side-effectful initializers; verify per field

examples.why: The one enum in this slice is printed as a sealed class deriving System.Enum with an explicit value__ field, so call sites show numeric default parameter values. 4 ISqrt overloads affected.
examples.fix: Print enum types as enum declarations and default parameter values as the named member.
examples.risk: low - the underlying type and constants are in metadata

examples.why: 79 foreach constructs (0 in ours) are emitted as GetEnumerator/MoveNext/get_Current/Dispose plus try/finally; 37 of the slice's 69 try/finally blocks are enumeration.
examples.fix: Pattern-match IEnumerable<T>.GetEnumerator on the receiver, an IEnumerator<T>/IEnumerator local, MoveNext in the loop test, get_Current at the loop head and a finally whose only content is a null-guarded Dispose.
examples.risk: medium - requires proving the enumerator shape and that the finally guard contains only Dispose; needs its own regression fixtures before enabling by default

affected_methods: OpenRA.Map (7 methods, incl. local functions in PostInit/Save)
partial_blocks.note: Admission gaps, not quality gaps. Every method has a body, so they are excluded from the line ratio and category counts; but their 2,919 lines of inline // IL_... dumps are 14% of the printed output and should collapse to one banner line in the readable view.

notes: Ours 20,380 lines vs ILSpy 4,260 (4.78x); per type Map 5.75x, World 4.82x, Game 4.41x, Actor 4.18x, Exts 4.06x.
1,777 of our 20,380 lines (8.7%) are compiler-generated closure/display/iterator types that ILSpy does not print at all; that portion of the ratio is a display decision, not decompilation quality.

Correction to the brief's string-printer hypothesis: \uXXXX escaping appears only on metadata constants (const string fields, default parameter values) - 1 instance here (Game.SavedScreenshot). ldstr literals print literally inside __cil_ldstr_<token>("...") - 146 instances, all readable text.
All five files emit zero using directives; ILSpy emits 62 across the five types.
No switch statements and no lock statements exist in either output for this slice, so neither is a gap here.

Semantics are preserved in every quality finding above. The only findings that need new analysis (rather than a printing/structuring pass) are foreach reconstruction, ?./?? recovery and for/while reconstruction.
Deliberate, low priority: iterator state machines (4), closure classes and using/try-finally lowering - the brief excludes this family.

Do not propose anything that drops an operation, reorders side effects, weakens an exception or hides a method; the recommended fixes are a comment-routing change, a printer/using change, accessor folding, CFG structuring and (last, with fixtures) foreach recovery.
FINDINGS.md carries 23 side-by-side examples: the brief's 8-15 guideline conflicts with its own 'at least three real examples per category' rule, and the latter forces 18+ for six categories.
